title: CyclePaintings
description: This mod makes placing Paintings not random anymore, but instead you always get the biggest possible one, and cycle through them in alphabetical order.
body:
# Take the pain out of paintings!

This mod makes placing Paintings not random anymore, but instead you always get the biggest possible one, and cycle through them in alphabetical order.

Hi, I am Bat, this is my fourth mod. It is quite small and simple,
I still hope you like it. ^^
